Help us make YANA a powerful and empathetic companion app for survivors of sexual assault. We're looking for people in the UK and India. Many in our team are survivors too. We get it. DMs open. Pls RT!
~
More info: https://t.co/figGc92HOb
#sexualassault #metoo #saam #rape https://t.co/DNTi2Spal4

And if you would rather talk to one of our team members about your experience, DM us. We can do a 40mins chat on Whatsapp chat, a phone call, in person or through audio notes. Whatever you feel comfortable with!  Responses will be anon. #metoo

The response to our research so far has been phenomenal. We have heard stories of so much pain but also of the desire to help other survivors. We're now looking to interview people who have reported their sexual assault or abuse to the police in UK and India. #metoo #rapesurvivor https://t.co/WOM8rsJ8Pa

"...twice asked the university to launch a formal investigation but she said on both occasions staff told her there were no specific procedures to deal with rape complaints, so no action could be taken." Shame @unibirmingham! #orangetheworld #metoo https://t.co/ectX2NfWuD

Knowledge is power. In 2019, we started building a tool for all victims and survivors of sexual abuse. A tool that will help you know everything they need –  rights, choices, steps & where to seek support. Get involved! https://t.co/figGc92HOb #16Days #OrangeTheWorld #metoo

Consent education matters. Schools, parents, workplaces and culture-setting organisations need to step up so we all stand up to rape. #16Days #OrangeTheWorld #metoo #GenerationEquality https://t.co/Onj2EaAOwD
@UNWomenUK All Chayn volunteers are calling on you to join @UN_Women for #GenerationEquality and stand against rape! Let’s #orangetheworld together. #16Days #MeToo https://t.co/Rm2OXAqjFL
